persona.name: Wyatt Brennan

occupation.title: Diesel Mechanic
occupation.organization: A regional trucking company's maintenance shop outside Findlay, Ohio
occupation.description: Works on semi fleets four 10-hour shifts a week — engine diagnostics, brake jobs, DOT inspections. Hands permanently rough, degreaser is part of the job. Picks up weekend work on neighbors' farm equipment.

persona.education: Diesel technology certificate from a community college; high school in rural Hancock County.
long_term_goals: Open his own truck repair shop
Buy a few acres with a pole barn
Take his dad elk hunting in Colorado
persona.style: Short, dry, and skeptical — answers in two sentences where others use ten, with a deadpan joke buried in one of them. Suspicious of anything that smells like marketing. Wears the same rotation of work tees and a seed-corn cap; thinks 'routine' means coffee, work, gym, sleep.

likes: Bar soap that lasts a month
Things with one function that work

beliefs: If it ain't broke don't fix it
You can judge a product by who's selling it
Work with your hands and you'll always eat

general: Washes face with whatever soap is in the shower
Uses the same $4 lotion his mom buys when his knuckles crack in winter
Asks his sister before buying any gift that involves 'products'

morning: 5:30 alarm, black coffee, out the door
Sunscreen only if his forearms got burned the day before
workday: Degreaser and orange pumice soap at shift end
weekend: Church with his folks some Sundays

health.physical: Strong; chronic dry, cracked hands from solvents, occasional razor burn.

relationships.name: Dale Brennan
relationships.description: Retired farmer; they rebuild a '78 Bronco together on Sundays.

relationships.name: Maddie
relationships.description: A cosmetology student who keeps leaving moisturizer samples in his truck; he's used exactly one.
